title: Assumptions vs reality — chest pain is women's most common heart attack symptom (VIRGO)
caption:
87% of women having a heart attack DO have chest pain (VIRGO, Circulation 2018). Still the #1 killer of US women (CDC).
Say it out loud: "I'm worried about my heart."
Send this to your mum. What did you assume?
www.aiforheratx.org
#womenshealth #hearthealth #heartdisease #womenover40 #gored

scenes.text: Everyone had a tidy explanation for it, and none of them were her heart.
phrases: It feels like something heavy is sitting on my chest.

scenes.text: 87% of women having a heart attack *did* have chest pain. Same as the men.

scenes.text: She almost cancelled. Instead she said one sentence out loud and got an *ECG* that morning.
phrases: She had the cancellation text half typed.
Then she put the phone face down.
They ran the ECG before she finished the form.

scenes.text: Write your top three symptoms with the times they start, then book a 20-minute walk tomorrow.
phrases: Note your top 3 symptoms and when they start.
At the appointment, say "I'm worried about my *heart*."
Build toward 150 minutes of moderate walking a week (WHO).
